title: Navimower 0.4.4

## Stable release

Navimower 0.4.4 promotes the tested 0.4.4 beta line through `0.4.4-beta39` to stable. There is no intentional runtime behavior change from beta39; this release changes stable release metadata only.

### Highlights

- **Multi-mower and map integration:** strengthens per-mower scoping, site-view metadata, zone handling and the authenticated Map API used by the companion Map Card.
- **Map positioning and underlays:** adds the integration-side georeference and map-underlay backend used for calibrated provider layers while keeping provider credentials and session secrets on the Home Assistant backend.
- **Gate and Custom Area support:** expands persistent gate-area/custom-area data and conservative fresh-position semantics for gate automations.
- **Mowing progress and history stability:** hardens current-cycle, coverage, completion and session semantics, including protection against stale vendor regressions after a confirmed completion.
- **State and command safety:** improves pause/resume handling, including paused-returning state `0221`, and keeps retained tasks from being replaced by unintended reset starts.
- **Validation and GPS safety:** validates explicit zone IDs only against authoritative decoded map geometry, allows existing vendor schedules to be disabled even when their stored periods are stale/invalid, rejects GPS `0/0`, and avoids forced Recorder churn for unchanged positions.
- **Diagnostics and privacy:** keeps Home Assistant Download diagnostics cached-only and sanitized, removes retired public research helpers, preserves useful firmware-version values, and keeps account/session/provider secrets backend-owned.
- **Interoperability:** public documentation is focused on user-facing Home Assistant behavior and interoperability while retaining project attribution and existing branding assets.

### Compatibility

- Existing Navimower config entries, entity/device unique IDs, map/history storage, scheduler state and gate/custom-area configuration are retained.
- Upgrading from Navimower 0.4.3 or any 0.4.4 beta does not require recreating the integration.
- No 0.4.4 beta needs to be installed before this stable release.
- **Navimower Map Card 0.3.6 is the matching stable card release.**
